title: Show a gray caption on the home screen
body:
Parent: #1

The home screen gains a one-line gray caption under the hero ("Play now — progress stays on this device"): the copy and the color follow the layout mock at `HomeView.swift:42`.

## Done when

- [ ] the flag is stored in UserDefaults (`HomeView.swift:42`) — owner: implementer
- [ ] a no-op analytics hook fires (`Analytics.swift:10`) — owner: implementer

## Handoff

```bash
git worktree add -b feat/65-caption ../r-65 origin/main
```

Closes #65
